feed.title: NPR Topics: News
feed.subtitle: NPR news, audio, and podcasts. Coverage of breaking stories, national and world news, politics, business, science, technology, and extended coverage of major national and world events.

entry.title: SCOTUS allows Trump's ballroom project to continue. And, the Army secretary resigns
entry.summary: The Supreme Court has ruled that President Trump's ballroom project may continue. And, Army Secretary Dan Driscoll resigns after 18 months on the job.

entry.title: They live by a shrine to a saint. Why are their homes being demolished?
entry.summary: The neighborhood is a pilgrimage site, with a shrine to the Sufi saint known as Bari Imam. In the past year, hundreds of homes of the working poor were razed. Residents fear more will be demolished.

entry.title: Whistleblower claims USPS plan for Trump's mail voting order could 'derail' midterms
entry.summary: A whistleblower says the U.S. Postal Service is rushing out an online system for President Trump's push to restrict mail voting that could "derail" the midterm election if courts allow it to proceed.

entry.title: A makeover for college: No gym, no meal plan and two years of work
entry.summary: A new model in Vermont emphasizes hands-on learning while stripping away frills like gyms and meal plans that increase costs. Other newly created institutions are also reimagining college.

entry.title: A NY hospital tried to close its birthing center. This city united to fight back
entry.summary: Democrats and Republicans in Troy, New York, took on a national Catholic health system and kept the county's last birthing center open.

entry.title: Judge to decide if Tyler Robinson will go to trial in Charlie Kirk murder case
entry.summary: Utah District Judge Tony Graf Jr. will hear arguments over evidence introduced in July, to decide if there's enough probable cause for a trial in the shooting of the conservative activist last year.

entry.title: AI wealth is creating a 'mansion shortage' and upending San Francisco's housing market
entry.summary: Spiking prices and rental bidding wars are raising fears of more displacement in a city where previous tech booms and a housing shortage have already driven out many.

entry.title: Made in America: How AI is keeping this U.S. factory competitive
entry.summary: GE Appliances is leaning heavily into artificial intelligence to improve quality and efficiency on the factory floor.

entry.title: Days after Trump announces Venezuela oil deal, White House fills in some of the details
entry.summary: As part of the deal, the U.S. is creating a private company as a joint venture with North American Blue Energy Partners, owned by Venezuelan businessman Alejandro Betancourt.

entry.title: Hindu pilgrims, on arduous trek, among Nepal's missing
entry.summary: Among the hundreds still missing on Nepal's border with China are Hindus from India and beyond, participating in a journey of devotion to a sacred mountain.
